# OpenCode 2 source import

One-time import of selected MIT-licensed OpenCode 2 client/TUI source.

- Upstream at time of import: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode
- Tag: v1.18.31
- Commit: 014614d35b397775e5d397a490fc72368c894ec2
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 opencode (see LICENSE)

This directory is provenance/reference. Wayshard clients in `clients/` are
independent copies adapted to the Wayshard HTTP/JSON + WebSocket API.

Wayshard does not maintain an upstream remote, submodule, fork relationship,
or OpenCode API compatibility target.
